Range.description: Half-open interval [from,to); from must precede to.

IngestionCreate.description: Exactly one input source. force always calls the upstream source; imported data is re-normalized into a new batch.

Value.description: kind determines the scalar type; null requires a missing_reason. Decimal uses string.

Expression.description: Bounded AST; server validates arity, types, units, lookback, depth, and allowed dataset visibility.

ValidationSplit.description: Chronologically ordered and non-overlapping; preprocessing uses development only. Server validates label overlap.

BacktestCreate.description: Positive initial cash; all models and benchmark must be compatible. No implicit market, currency, zero fee or fill defaults.

JobEvent.description: Sequence is a string to avoid browser integer precision loss.

ResearchSeries.description: JSON artifact format for factor IC, coverage and grouped-return series; large outputs are split into ordered artifacts.

ComparisonResult.description: JSON artifact returned by a completed comparison job. Basis mismatches must remain visible.

Record.description: Field schemas and units are returned in record_schema; parent_id traces the causal chain.

ExportCreate.description: Server rejects unsupported kind/format combinations and unauthorized raw-data exports.

params.description: Validated using the referenced registered parameter schema; not arbitrary executable code.

ScreenInputBinding.description: Distinct binding_id values are required for parameterized factors; the same factor with different params is a different binding.

oneOf.description: At least one bound must be present; lower must not exceed upper.

ScreenCondition.description: Typed condition tree; node_id is unique within a screener version and locates per-condition explanations and issues. Three-valued: NOT unknown = unknown, AND is false-dominant, OR is true-dominant; only a true root enters ranking. See docs/stock-screening-design.md.

ScreenScoreComponent.description: Weights are non-negative, submitted normalized, sum to 1 and are never re-distributed when a component is missing.

ScreenRanking.description: Mutually exclusive ranking modes. instrument_id ascending is always appended as the stable tie-breaker; instruments missing ranking values never rank, without zero-filling.

ScreenSelection.description: Fewer than N qualified instruments returns all of them; unqualified instruments are never padded in.

ScreenRunCreate.description: All inputs are frozen at submission; no implicit snapshot, universe, time or policy defaults. source_run_id links a re-run to its origin.

ScreenPreflight.description: Read-only check; submitting a run re-validates and may still fail.

ScreenSummary.description: Stage counts are mutually exclusive and conserve: population = condition_false + condition_unknown + condition_true; condition_true = rank_insufficient + rankable; rankable = selected + not_selected.

ScreenRun.description: summary and rows stay unset until the run publishes; earlier access returns 409 result_not_ready.

ScreenRow.description: Excluded rows have a null rank and sort after selected and rankable rows; values carry display columns with missing reasons.

ScreenNodeEvaluation.description: Per-node evidence mirroring the condition tree; unknown is a distinct truth value, never coerced. Explanations reference frozen data, not current values.

ScreenScoreEvidence.description: Missing components keep their declared weight with no redistribution; raw_value and percentile are then null with the missing reason carried by the Value.

ScreenExplanation.description: score is empty in sort mode. stage is the single mutually exclusive classification used by ScreenSummary.

ScreenUniverseCreate.description: Saves all selected instruments of a successful run as a new static universe; an empty selection returns 422 empty_selection.

ReplayConfig.description: Frozen inputs for a historical replay session. day_end_policy, cash_policy, end_policy and order_types are explicit validated strings; supported model/parameter values are declared by the referenced versioned Model and rejected otherwise (no implicit defaults).

ReplayPreflight.description: Read-only check of config, data coverage and referenced model availability; creating the session re-validates.

ReplaySession.description: ReplaySession can span multiple Jobs and real days; revision is the optimistic-concurrency token every mutating command must match.

SessionCommand.description: Base for every mutating replay command; command_id keys idempotency, expected_revision guards optimistic concurrency. Browsers never supply a historical decision time.

ManualOrderCreate.description: User provides trade intent only; fills are determined by the model, never by the client.

ManualOrder.description: Rejected orders keep a persisted rejected state with a reason; cancellation only affects unfilled remainder, never historical fills.

summary.description: Validated using the referenced registered parameter schema; not arbitrary executable code.

ReplayStep.description: A committed daily simulation checkpoint; recovery atomically republishes from the last committed checkpoint.

ReplayDataQuery.description: Data is truncated to the session current_as_of by the server; future reads are rejected, never preloaded.

ReplayScreenRunCreate.description: snapshot, universe and as_of come from the session; the browser cannot shift to a future point.

detail.description: Validated using the referenced registered parameter schema; not arbitrary executable code.

ReplayEvent.description: Persistent business log; Job SSE with a window cap is not a substitute for full trading history.
